html.legal.agb:
General Terms and Conditions

As of: August 2026

1. Scope

These terms and conditions apply to the purchase of digital wallpaper collections via this website by consumers residing in Germany and the EU.

2. Provider

The contractual partner is the provider named in the Imprint.

3. Description of services

The subject matter is digital image files (wallpapers) in high resolution, no physical shipping. The Essential Collection includes 100 images in 4K. The premium collection includes over 200 motifs as well as additional formats (including ultrawide, iPad, lock screen).

4. Prices and payment

All prices are final prices in euros and include statutory sales tax, unless the small business regulation according to Section 19 UStG applies (see imprint). Payment is made once. There is no subscription.

5. Conclusion of contract

By clicking on the payment button you are making a binding offer. The contract is concluded when we confirm payment and activate the download.

6. Delivery

Delivery takes place immediately after receipt of payment via the download button on the confirmation page. You need a stable internet connection. The download link is valid for 7 days.

7. Rights of use

You receive a non-exclusive, non-transferable right to use the wallpapers for private use on your own devices. Redistribution, resale, publication or commercial use of the files is not permitted.

8. Revocation

The cancellation policy applies. For digital content, the right of withdrawal expires if you expressly agree that we begin execution before the deadline expires and you confirm that you thereby lose your right of withdrawal.

9. Satisfaction Guarantee

Regardless of the legal cancellation, we grant: 14 days money back for the Essential Collection and 30 days for the Premium Collection. Write to us at the imprint address.

10. Liability

We have unlimited liability for intent and gross negligence. In the case of slight negligence, only in the event of a breach of essential contractual obligations and limited to foreseeable, typical damage. Liability for life, body, health and under the Product Liability Act remains unaffected.

11. Final provisions

The law of the Federal Republic of Germany applies, excluding the UN Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods. Mandatory consumer protection regulations in your country of residence remain unaffected.
html.legal.datenschutz:
Data protection declaration

Protecting your data is important to us. This statement informs you about the processing of personal data on this website in accordance with the GDPR.

1. Responsible person

Responsible within the meaning of the GDPR is the provider named in the Imprint.

2. Hosting

When you access the site, technically necessary data (IP address, date, time, page accessed, browser type) is processed in server logs. Legal basis: Art. 6 Para. 1 lit. f GDPR (legitimate interest in stability and security).

3. Orders

If you purchase a collection, we process your name, email address, billing address and payment data in order to fulfill the contract (Art. 6 Para. 1 lit. b GDPR) and to comply with legal retention obligations (Art. 6 Para. 1 lit. c GDPR).

Payments can be processed via external providers (e.g. Stripe, PayPal, Klarna). Their data protection information applies.

4. Download and delivery

After purchasing, a download button will be available on the confirmation page. Digital content is delivered exclusively electronically.

5. Contact

If you write to us, we will process your information to process the request (Art. 6 Para. 1 lit. b or f GDPR).

6. Cookies

We only use technically necessary cookies unless specifically consented to. Marketing cookies (e.g. meta pixels) only with consent (Art. 6 Para. 1 lit. a GDPR, TTDSG/TDDDG).

7. Storage period

We store contract and invoice data in accordance with commercial and tax law periods (usually 10 years). We delete inquiries when they have been completed, at the latest after 24 months, unless there is an obligation to retain them.

8. Your rights

  • Information (Art. 15 GDPR)
  • Correction (Art. 16 GDPR)
  • Deletion (Art. 17 GDPR)
  • Restriction (Art. 18 GDPR)
  • Data portability (Art. 20 GDPR)
  • Objection (Art. 21 GDPR)
  • Revocation of consent (Art. 7 Para. 3 GDPR)

You can also complain to a supervisory authority, e.g. B. from the state data protection officer in your federal state.

9. Obligation to provide

We cannot deliver the collection without the data required for the contract (email, payment details).

html.legal.widerruf:
Cancellation policy

Right of withdrawal

You have the right to cancel this contract within fourteen days without giving any reasons. The cancellation period is fourteen days from the day the contract is concluded.

In order to exercise your right of withdrawal, you must inform us (see Imprint, email: kontakt@atelierwallpapers.de) of your decision by means of a clear statement (e.g. email). You can use the sample cancellation form for this, but this is not mandatory.

To meet the deadline, it is sufficient that you send the message before the cancellation period has expired.

Consequences of revocation

If you revoke this contract, we must repay all payments that we have received from you immediately and at the latest within fourteen days from the day on which we received notification of your revocation. For this repayment we use the same payment method that you used for the original transaction, unless something different was expressly agreed with you; Under no circumstances will you be charged any fees for this repayment.

Premature expiry of digital content

The right of withdrawal expires in the case of a contract for the delivery of digital content that is not on a physical data carrier if we have started executing the contract after you have expressly agreed that we will begin execution before the end of the withdrawal period and you have confirmed your knowledge that by agreeing to this, you will lose your right of withdrawal at the start of execution.
